name: bge-skimming-analytics
title: BGE Skimming Analytics - Merged Dataset
description: Merged dataset containing barcode validation results from BGE genome skimming project

fields.name: BOLD_submission
fields.description: BOLD Systems submission identifier

fields.name: ambig_basecount
fields.description: Number of ambiguous (N) bases within the extracted barcode region

fields.name: ambig_full_basecount
fields.description: Number of ambiguous bases across the full barcode consensus sequence

fields.name: ambig_original
fields.description: Number of ambiguous bases across the full barcode consensus sequence prior to barcode region extraction

fields.name: assembly_params
fields.description: Number of assembly parameters explored (6 or 24)

fields.name: cleaning_ambig_bases
fields.description: Number of ambiguous bases in the post-cleaned barcode consensus sequence

fields.name: cleaning_cov_percent
fields.description: Percentage coverage of pseudo-reference used for read alignment and barcode extraction in the post-cleaning consensus sequence

fields.name: cleaning_removed_at
fields.description: Number of aligned reads removed due to AT content filtering in BGEE pipeline

fields.name: cleaning_removed_human
fields.description: Number of aligned reads removed due to human COI similarity in BGEE pipeline

fields.name: cleaning_removed_outlier
fields.description: Number of aligned reads flagged as statistical outliers and removed in BGEE pipeline

fields.name: cleaning_removed_reference
fields.description: Number of reads removed due to reference filtering during cleaning

fields.name: cov_avg
fields.description: Average read coverage depth of pseudo-reference used for consensus sequence generation

fields.name: cov_max
fields.description: Maximum read coverage depth at a single position

fields.name: cov_med
fields.description: Median read coverage depth across barcode consensus sequence

fields.name: cov_min
fields.description: Minimum read coverage depth at a single position

fields.name: dataset
fields.description: Name of input multi-FASTA file that was validated

fields.name: error
fields.description: Error message during barcode validation (if present)

fields.name: fasta_header
fields.description: Sequence header parsed from input FASTA file

fields.name: fcleaner
fields.description: Indicates whether FASTA cleaner (fcleaner) data cleaning step was applied

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: Identifier for a group of sequences (e.g. from the same sample), usually BOLD Process ID

fields.name: identification
fields.description: Taxonomic identification from input taxonomy at 'identification_rank'

fields.name: identification_method
fields.description: Taxonomic validation method (e.g. bold/blast)

fields.name: identification_rank
fields.description: Taxonomic rank to validate molecular taxonomy of consensus sequence to (e.g. family)

fields.name: inst
fields.description: Institute that processed the data (Naturalis Biodiversity Center or Natural History Museum)

fields.name: length
fields.description: Sequence length

fields.name: marker_code
fields.description: Target barcode (e.g. COI-5P)

fields.name: merge
fields.description: Indicates whether data merging operation was applied

fields.name: mge_params
fields.description: MitoGeneExtractor (MGE) parameter string used for consensus recovery within the BGEE pipeline

fields.name: n_reads_aligned
fields.description: Number of input reads aligned to the pseudo-reference by MGE and used for generation of the consensus sequence

fields.name: n_reads_in
fields.description: Number of QC'd/trimmed reads input into MGE

fields.name: n_reads_skipped
fields.description: Number of input reads omitted from alignment (e.g. due to frame shifts/multiple alignment positions/mismatches/etc.)

fields.name: nuc_basecount
fields.description: Base count of HMM-extracted barcode region (i.e. 'sequence')

fields.name: nuc_full_basecount
fields.description: Base count of full consensus sequence

fields.name: obs_taxon
fields.description: Top taxonomic assignment(s) at the 'identification_rank' returned by the selected 'identification_method'

fields.name: r
fields.description: MGE parameter r value

fields.name: reading_frame
fields.description: Open reading frame (ORF) of 'sequence'

fields.name: ref_accession
fields.description: Reference sequence accession number

fields.name: ref_length
fields.description: Length of pseudo-reference used for generation of the consensus sequence

fields.name: ref_rank
fields.description: Taxonomic rank of reference sequence

fields.name: s
fields.description: MGE parameter s value

fields.name: sample_taxid
fields.description: Sample taxonomic ID

fields.name: sequence
fields.description: HMM-extracted barcode region of consensus sequence generated by MGE

fields.name: sequence_id
fields.description: Consensus sequence unique identifier for the focal sequence from the input 'dataset'

fields.name: species
fields.description: Morphological identification to the lowest available taxonomic rank (e.g. species, often)

fields.name: stop_codons
fields.description: Number of stop codons identified in 'sequence'

fields.name: validation_steps
fields.description: Number of validation steps applied (1 or 2)
